notes.title: 🐾 Crafting Animal AI: Inside the Heart of Pet Shelter Simulator!
notes.content:
Hello pet lovers and future shelter managers!

We're excited to share a behind-the-scenes look at the development of Pet Shelter Simulator! Currently, our main focus is crafting the heart and soul of the game: the animal AI.

Animals are central to the game's experience, and their behaviors, emotions, and interactions are critical for creating an engaging and realistic simulation. To ensure we develop efficiently without compromising on quality, we're implementing the State Machine design pattern. This approach helps us create clear, manageable, and responsive behaviors for all our furry friends!

We’d love to hear your thoughts and ideas! What kind of behaviors, emotions, or interactions would you like to see in our animal AI? Let’s discuss and shape this journey together!

Stay pawsome,The Pet Shelter Simulator Team 🐶🐱🐾
